name: prompt-toc
description: Markdown-style TOC pane of your prompts and reply headings; press one to scroll there. Prompts-only chip, time per prompt, follow-viewport underline, settings (open on start, show time), /compact divider, `/prompt-toc <keyword>` filter, `/prompt-toc-export [path]` Markdown export

openByDefault.title: Open pane on start
openByDefault.description: Open the Prompt TOC pane at session start (wide terminals only)

showTime.title: Show time
showTime.description: Draw the time of each prompt in the Prompt TOC pane
